text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Curren Bouquetd'or told me she was entering a local game tournament with some friends, so I came to cheer her on!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Tons of rivals and tons of spectators!
My burning spirit is at 80 miles per hour!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
We compete across all 4 events for total points, right?
It'd be best to rack up points in the events we're good at.
Don't you think, Maru-chan? ♡

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Thank you very much for coming.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I will—do my absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
The first event is tongue twisters!
Loud and clear now~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Sea urchin, tasty, nummy.
No wait, melon's nummy.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Okay! I'm pretty confident in my enunciation♪

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Yay~! That's our Love-chan!
Flawless♪ *clap clap*~!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Sea urchin, so tasty, so nummy.
No wait, melon's nummy too...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Phew—
Did I manage to get it across, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Next is charades!
If the judges can guess what's being acted out,
you earn points!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My theme is...!
Hmm, something like this, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! It's "Ballerina"!
Hahaha, I knew it right away!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Gran-san—!
Umm... My topic is...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Hmph—!
I hope it gets through to them...!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Drawing Quiiiiz! What did I draw?
We'll have the audience vote using the app!
Now, let's put the illustration up on the monitor, bam!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Oh! It's a "trumpet"!
It looks so realistic~!
Everyone's definitely getting this one right~!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
This one is... a "gorilla"!
Wait, doesn't it look kind of like that thing?
A "Moai statue"...?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"And finally, 'Puppy Race Predictions'!
The neighborhood kids have gathered here with us!
Entry Number 1—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Number 3, her gait is smooth and nice. High potential. But is she in a bad mood?
For now, maybe a '▲'. Next is—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
The one that looks fast is... number 7, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Goal!! In first place is Number 7!
Chrono Genesis nails the top three,
predicting 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place dead-on~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume showcasing their individual talents
captured the audience's attention.
However...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now, it's time for the results announcement.
The champion is~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Curren Bouquetd'or!!
Unbelievable, with 2nd place finishes across all 4 events, she's 1st place in overall points!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I thought so...
You've always scored high
in every single event, after all...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Right! She was super good at
both the gestures and the drawing!
Bouquet-san is a hundred miles of talent!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! You didn't miss
a single event, did you?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah! That's so cool♪
Being able to do anything is so awesome~!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Oh no, you're too kind. I'm truly humbled.
choice_data_list: You really are amazing, you know.
You really are amazing, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Even you, Trainer...
Thank you, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that girl won?
Somehow I missed it, but wow, she's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I saw it! I noticed halfway through~
Isn't that amazing? You handled it so effortlessly.
I think I might become a fan~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...!
I'm actually—feeling a bit shy.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It was... a fun time.
Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Bouquetd'or looked delighted.
Seeing her like this reaffirmed my belief that she is truly an exceptional Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Bouquetd'or looked delighted.
Seeing her like this reaffirmed my belief that she is truly an exceptional Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Being praised like that... it tickles, in a way.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Still—I'm very happy.
Fufufufu...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...You've always been watching over me, haven't you, Trainer?
From the very beginning...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—I wanted to answer them.
Your cheers, that is.
